row: Extra Care Physiotherapy (Spine and Neuro Rehab )

Since its inception in 2006, we at Extra Care Physiotherapy Centre have been striving to provide best physiotherapy treatment in comfort of your home. With having a team of experienced & certified physiotherapists, we always follow the best practices in medical care that help us to offer effective, people-centric and result oriented back pain treatment, neck pain treatment and knee joint pain treatment in Lucknow. The main aim of our expert team is to achieve highest standards of care in home physiotherapy by maintaining international protocols and standards.
Being the leading physiotherapy clinic in Lucknow, we always bring transparency in our healthcare service giving complete and detailed reports to the patients about their problems. This practice not just helps us to win the trust of patients but also enhances our brand value. We provide dedicated treatment plans keeping in mind different symptoms of different patients.
